topic: How does the 14.6% bandwidth affect frequency planning for multi-satellite networks with adjacent channel interference risks?
consensus_response: The 14.6% bandwidth limitation increases adjacent channel interference, compromising link performance. Optimizing frequency allocation and dynamic channel assignment can mitigate effects. Beamforming techniques spatially filter out interference, but increase processing overhead. Non-uniform satellite constellations optimize coverage, reducing interference, but introduce beamforming complexity.
reference_context: SatCom systems operate on allocated frequencies, with bandwidth depending on mission requirements and link parameters.
